					75 heading Health Advisory, Value: 4
						76 text Health Advisory
					77 text Healthy persons: 
					78 text PSI Forecast-Unhealthy to Very Unhealthy. To plan for 17 Oct, avoid prolonged or strenuous outdoor physical exertion. For immediate outdoor activities, use 1h PM2.5. If Elevated PM2.5, reduce strenuous outdoor activity. If High PM2.5, avoid strenuous outdoor activity. 
					79 text Elderly, pregnant women & children: 
					80 text PSI Forecast-Unhealthy to Very Unhealthy. To plan for 17 Oct, minimise outdoor activity. For immediate outdoor activities, use 1h PM2.5. If Elevated PM2.5, avoid strenuous outdoor activity for the next hour. If High PM2.5, avoid all outdoor activity for next hour, may wear a mask to reduce exposure.
					81 text Persons with chronic lung/heart disease: 
					82 text PSI Forecast-Unhealthy to Very Unhealthy. To plan for 17 Oct, avoid outdoor activity. For immediate outdoor activities, use 1h PM2.5. If Elevated PM2.5, avoid strenuous outdoor activity for the next hour. If High PM2.5, avoid all outdoor activity for next hour, may wear a mask to reduce exposure. Use the PSI forecast and corresponding health advisories for planning next-day outdoor activities. Use the 1-hr PM2.5 readings and personal guide to plan immediate outdoor activities.
					83 container
						84 text Singapore, 16 October 2026 – The PSI forecast for 17 Oct 2026 is  150 – 230 (Unhealthy to Very Unhealthy)
					85 text . 
					86 text 2.           The PSI forecast and corresponding health advisories should be used for planning next day outdoor activities. 
					87 text 3.           For immediate outdoor activities, please check the 1-hr PM2.5 concentration readings and personal guide on our haze microsite (www.haze.gov.sg) or mobile app (myENV).
					88 text Update on Hotspot and Haze Situation
					89 text 4.          Showers fell over a few parts of Singapore this afternoon. As at 8pm, the 1-hr PM2.5 concentration readings were 44 – 148 µg/m3, in (Band 1, Normal / Band 2, Elevated), and the 24-hr PSI was 159 – 222, in the Unhealthy to Very Unhealthy range. Dense smoke haze from fires in Kalimantan continued to drift towards Singapore under prevailing southeasterly winds. Smoke haze was also observed over Sumatra.
					90 text 5.          For tomorrow, some showers are expected over Singapore and the surrounding region, including over parts of Kalimantan. With the winds forecast to shift to blow from the southeast or south-southeast, the transport of smoke haze from Kalimantan to Singapore may be reduced. However, some smoke haze from Sumatra may drift towards Singapore.
					91 text 6.          On Sunday and Monday, showers are forecast over Singapore and parts of Kalimantan. Winds are expected to gradually weaken and blow from the southeast or south. This could further decrease the transport of smoke haze from Kalimantan to Singapore, although some smoke haze from Sumatra may drift towards Singapore.
					92 text Activity Guidelines
					93 text 7.         The health impact of haze is dependent on one’s health status, the PSI level, and the length and intensity of outdoor activity.  8.        For updates, visit our haze microsite (
